defects.title: CORS header rejection when accessing frontend via 127.0.0.1:5173
defects.expected: Preflight CORS check should allow both localhost and 127.0.0.1
defects.actual: CORS preflight blocked request because FRONTEND_ORIGIN was strictly set to http://localhost:5173
defects.recommendedFix: Update FRONTEND_ORIGIN to include both http://localhost:5173,http://127.0.0.1:5173 in backend configuration

defects.title: Playwright E2E configuration hardcodes port 5174 instead of Vite default 5173
defects.expected: Playwright tests should target running dev server at http://localhost:5173
defects.actual: Playwright failed with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://localhost:5174
defects.recommendedFix: Align playwright.config.ts baseURL with vite default port 5173

defects.title: ServiceTicket model reference error in database inspection tool
defects.expected: All model counts should execute without exceptions
defects.actual: Script throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading count) for serviceTicket
defects.likelyRootCause: Prisma schema does not define a ServiceTicket model (tickets are handled under fieldWorkJob / hierarchyRequest)
defects.recommendedFix: Remove serviceTicket from models array in inspect_counts.js

defects.title: Missing accessible DialogTitle in Radix UI modal components
steps: 1. Open modals in Dashboard or POS
defects.expected: DialogContent should include DialogTitle or VisuallyHidden Title for WCAG screen reader accessibility
defects.actual: Radix UI logs warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible
defects.likelyRootCause: Dialog headers omit explicit DialogTitle component
